title: Alert when VaR passes 0.95% of NAV
author: israelpollak-hub
body:
From the Oct 9 risk review. Current 1-day 99% VaR is 0.92% of NAV versus the 1.00% limit.

Add a warning alert at 0.95% that emails Joe Smith and Daniel Okafor. A breach at 1.00% should also notify Rachel Stein's team via Joe.

Owner: Daniel Okafor. Implementation: Priya Natarajan.
